analysis: public CAL FIRE DINS Camp Fire incident comparison against provided USFS WRC minus Overture building-count differences; discovery only

license.recorded_terms: Dataset catalogue metadata: Creative Commons Attribution (license id `cc-by`); version not specified. Catalogue license URL: http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by. No separate licenseInfo is supplied by the ArcGIS layer.
license.version_caveat: Catalogue says Creative Commons Attribution but does not identify a CC version; retain attribution and do not imply a more specific version.

dins_source.published_limitations: Catalogue description says the database documents structures within the California State Responsibility Area inside or within 300 feet of a fire perimeter; inspection access and fire damage can prevent identification, so not all impacted structures may be identified and a small margin of error is expected.

spatial_join.tract_join_method: point covered by provided tract polygon; if a point lies on/within multiple boundaries, assign to lexicographically smallest GEOID

comparison.provided_count_difference_definition: usfs_BuildingCount_sum minus Overture overture_buildings; not an organiser target
comparison.ratio_definition: (provided USFS building count - Overture building count) / DINS destroyed records; null when destroyed count is zero
comparison.relative_error_definition: abs((provided USFS building count - Overture building count) - DINS destroyed records) / DINS destroyed records; null when destroyed count is zero
comparison.spearman_definition: Spearman rank correlation with average ranks between DINS destroyed-record count and provided USFS minus Overture difference across all official NorCal tracts whose provided MTBS last-burn year equals 2018; zero DINS is retained

decision.verdict_summary: The registered mechanism rule did not pass; the DINS counts do not meet both focal error and all-2018 cohort Spearman thresholds.

spearman.x: Camp Fire DINS destroyed records per official NorCal tract
spearman.y: provided USFS building count minus Overture buildings
spearman.cohort: all official NorCal tracts with last provided MTBS burn year 2018

opposite_direction.cohort: all 591 official NorCal sample tracts, with no last-burn-year restriction
opposite_direction.interpretation_limit: zero Camp Fire DINS records may reflect fire-incident mismatch, SRA/perimeter scope, inspection omissions, or later rebuilding; these data do not distinguish these explanations
